newsitem.title: USA: Ralston Purina spinoff delayed to 1998.
newsitem.headline: Ralston Purina spinoff delayed to 1998.

text.p: Ralston Purina Co. said Monday it now expects to complete a tax-free spinoff of its international agricultural feeds business in early 1998, instead of this year.

The St. Louis, Mo.-based company attributed the extension to complexities involved in spinning off the business, which includes 60 animal feed milling operations in 16 countries. The unit had sales of about $1.4 billion in fiscal 1996.
In March 1996, Ralston Purina announced the tax-free spinoff, which requires a favourable Internal Revenue Service ruling and approval by Ralston Purina's directors.
Ralston Purina's stock rose 50 cents to $81.625 on the New York Stock Exchange in early afternoon trading.
